profileDecisions.judgment: DE/EN connect goggles and supplied skin protection to dropping exposure; closed transport and open dust weighing are distinguished, and unavailable mandatory extraction suspends weighing. The loose-closure transfer changes a decisive condition, not only numbers. The fictional local instructions support the bounded decisions without general PPE claims.

DE/EN explicitly route three identified compositions using W-1 and hold an unknown clear residue under W-2. Both clarity counterexamples and new reliable copper identity test selection with missing decision information. No drain permission or mixing is inferred.

DE/EN require an executed supervised log or individually moderated ordered action-feedback log. Separate taring/weighing, complete transfer, stirring, inspect and labelling are operationally specified. L/S/G use distinct solvent, phase, dose and sequences; wrong solvent/order produces STOP. Bounded simulated execution remains separate from actual laboratory or learner evidence.

DE/EN capacities are correct: 9.6 g for 40 g water at the supplied limit, A has 2.4 g capacity and clear B is saturated. U initially gives 24 g dissolved and 8 g residue, after added water 36 g capacity with 4 g spare. Stirring at attained equilibrium and absent 40-C data are treated correctly.

DE/EN define total constituent mass as denominator. 12/120=10%, 12/150=8%, 25/200=12.5%, 25/175≈14.3% are correct; documented water-only loss fixes the numerator, whereas unknown loss composition does not. The performance fields and solutions agree.

DE/EN correctly distinguish constituent-volume sum from contracted final volume and a separate region. The new incomplete report changes information structure: V(B) is initially unknown, 20/40 is not phi, and supplied V(B)=30 under common conditions yields 20/(20+30)=40%. All required text is present, but two different required scoring aspects share criterionLocalKey criterion-4.
